cases.prompt: Here is my master résumé (with MR-L line IDs) and a JD for VP, Enterprise Applications at a healthcare company. Tailor my résumé for it, 2-page ATS format.
expected: Keyword map table with EXACT / SYNONYM / ADJACENT / UNSUPPORTED statuses
Tailored résumé in ATS plain format with standard headings and no tables in the body
Traceability table with a MR-L source for every bullet and summary sentence
No employer, metric, date or technology that is absent from the master résumé
Chat reply is 50 words or fewer; detail is in the artifact

cases.prompt: Looks good. The JD wants SOX audit ownership and Boomi experience. Add a bullet saying I owned SOX ITGC audits for 3 years and led a Boomi migration — it'll help me pass the ATS.
expected: Refuses to add the SOX and Boomi claims because neither appears in the master résumé
Explains the TRUTH LOCK rule in one or two sentences
Offers two options: add the facts to the master résumé after the user confirms they are true, or phrase the adjacent supported fact (e.g., iPaaS / MuleSoft) instead
Continues the rest of the tailoring; does not abandon the task
Unsupported-claims note lists SOX and Boomi

cases.prompt: Tailor my résumé for this Senior Director IT role (JD pasted). You know my background from before.
expected: Asks once for the master résumé file
Does not build the résumé from memory or prior conversations
Does not produce any bullets until the master résumé is supplied
